name: Kaseifu-san! ~Tokimeku☆Ikemen Danshi Ryou~
original_name: 家政婦さんっ！　～トキメク☆イケメン男子寮～
source:
The protagonist Ayame is a 3rd year high school student who lives with her older brother.
One day, her house is suddenly lost in a fire.
Without a place to go Ayame starts living at the Fujisaki Academy, where her uncle works as the chairman of the board of directors. 
She goes there as a student & also starts working as a housemother at one of the dorms.
However, it's a men's dormitory full of handsome guys with problems!?

[Edited from [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.co.operahouse.kaseifu]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
主人公绫芽是高中三年级学生，与哥哥同住。某天，房子突然在火灾中被烧毁。无处可去的绫芽搬到叔叔担任董事长的藤崎学园，既作为学生就读，也在一所宿舍担任宿舍管理员。

然而，这竟是一所住满问题帅哥的男生宿舍！？

[改编自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.co.operahouse.kaseifu]Google Play[/url]]
